interactive.label: Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected file from the list.

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Empty the list without deleting any file.

interactive.label: Analysis regions
interactive.tooltip: Restrict detection to named regions; empty or disabled regions use the entire frame.

interactive.label: detector_chs_text
interactive.tooltip: Space-separated routing channels; even = parallel (∥), odd = perpendicular (⊥).

interactive.label: mtr_start
interactive.tooltip: Fit-window start on the binned micro-time axis.

interactive.label: mtr_stop
interactive.tooltip: Fit-window stop on the binned micro-time axis.

interactive.label: micro_time_binning
interactive.tooltip: Integer down-binning of the micro-time axis before fitting.

interactive.label: region_set
interactive.tooltip: Which detection in the measurement's container to fit, when it holds more than one. Regions are found by the Spot Finder; this tool fits the ones it is given.

interactive.label: min_photons
interactive.tooltip: Regions with fewer photons in the fit window are not fitted; they keep a row, with NaN parameters.

interactive.label: tau
interactive.tooltip: Initial fluorescence lifetime.

interactive.label: fix τ
interactive.tooltip: Hold the lifetime fixed.

interactive.label: gamma
interactive.tooltip: Initial scatter fraction.

interactive.label: fix γ
interactive.tooltip: Hold the scatter fraction fixed.

interactive.label: r0
interactive.tooltip: Fundamental anisotropy.

interactive.label: fix r0
interactive.tooltip: Hold the fundamental anisotropy fixed.

interactive.label: rho
interactive.tooltip: Rotational correlation time.

interactive.label: fix ρ
interactive.tooltip: Hold the rotational correlation time fixed.

interactive.label: l1
interactive.tooltip: Polarisation mixing correction l1.

interactive.label: l2
interactive.tooltip: Polarisation mixing correction l2.

interactive.label: 2I* (P+2S)
interactive.tooltip: Optimise P+2S instead of P and S separately.

interactive.label: BIFL scatter
interactive.tooltip: Reduce Istar by the background contribution.

interactive.label: Load demo
interactive.tooltip: Simulate a field whose regions have known lifetimes, detect them with the standard workflow, and fill this panel in — so a fitted lifetime can be checked against an answer.

interactive.label: Preview
interactive.tooltip: Measure the regions about to be fitted, without fitting them — the same regions the run uses.

interactive.label: Run
interactive.tooltip: Fit every detected region in every selected file; writes molecule_data.tsv + joint_output.tsv.

interactive.label: Export
interactive.tooltip: Export the combined per-molecule table (all files) to a TSV/CSV.

interactive.label: Open results…
interactive.tooltip: Reopen a saved molecule_data.tsv (or joint_output.tsv) from a previous analysis to browse its molecules.

interactive.label: Filter regions
interactive.tooltip: Show only regions whose name contains this text; the image is unchanged.
